categories.main_business_segments: Houpu Clean Energy Group primarily operates in clean energy equipment manufacturing, focusing on natural gas and hydrogen refueling equipment, aviation parts manufacturing, energy engineering EPC services, and smart IoT integrated management platforms. The company also engages in shipborne LNG equipment and aviation military equipment sectors, providing comprehensive solutions across the clean energy industry chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in natural gas and hydrogen refueling systems, including proprietary high-pressure hydrogen refueling equipment breaking international monopolies. It employs EPC project management for large-scale energy engineering, modular design for shipborne LNG systems, and AI-driven knowledge management platforms (AIGC knowledge hub) to enhance product value. Manufacturing involves in-house production of core components and outsourcing of standard and non-standard parts, with a sales-driven production model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major Chinese oil and gas companies such as CNPC, Sinopec, CNOOC, various gas groups, transportation groups, logistics companies, and port terminals. The company serves domestic markets extensively and has international projects in Europe, Africa, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, and the Americas, including notable projects in France, Germany, the UK, Russia, and Portugal.
categories.geographic_coverage: Houpu operates nationwide across all 31 provinces in China and has expanded internationally with projects and market presence in Europe (France, Germany, UK, Portugal), Africa, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, and the Americas. The company is headquartered in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, with multiple subsidiaries and offices across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the clean energy supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, integration, and installation of clean energy refueling equipment and related engineering services. It also provides after-sales services and smart IoT platform solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider within the clean energy equipment ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Houpu emphasizes technology leadership and innovation-driven growth, focusing on hydrogen energy full-industry chain solutions, including hydrogen production, storage, and refueling technologies. R&D priorities include PEM and alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production, high-pressure hydrogen refueling systems, liquid hydrogen pumps, and methanol supply systems for ships. The company integrates AI technologies (AIGC knowledge hub) to enhance product intelligence and service capabilities, aiming to expand international markets and improve operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized natural gas and hydrogen refueling equipment, engineering design and construction contracts (EPC), and after-sales services. The company also earns income from aviation parts manufacturing and smart IoT platform services. Sales are predominantly direct to major energy operators and equipment contractors, with long project cycles and large contract values.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Houpu is a leading domestic player in China's clean energy equipment sector, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise with significant market share and competitive advantages. It has broken international monopolies in key hydrogen refueling technologies and holds multiple national and provincial technology certifications. Competitors include other domestic and international clean energy equipment manufacturers, but Houpu maintains a strong position through technological innovation and comprehensive industry chain integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Houpu reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 630 million, a 32.67% decrease year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 82 million, reflecting a 17.38% decline. Total assets stood at RMB 2.23 billion with net assets of RMB 1.15 billion. Despite recent revenue declines due to strategic order adjustments and subsidiary restructuring, the company maintains a solid asset base and sufficient order backlog, with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Houpu differentiates itself by offering integrated, full-industry chain clean energy solutions combining advanced natural gas and hydrogen refueling technologies, proprietary core components, and AI-enabled smart management platforms. Its products break international technology monopolies, provide high reliability and efficiency, and are supported by comprehensive after-sales services and a nationwide service network. The company emphasizes innovation, cost-effectiveness, and customization to meet diverse customer needs, aiming to be a global leader in clean energy equipment solutions.
